autoreview.description: Run the autoreview closeout reviewer on a change bundle (local | branch | commit).
autoreview.template:
Run the autoreview closeout review now.

Target mode: $ARGUMENTS (if empty, use `auto` — dirty local changes first, else current PR base via `gh pr view`, else `origin/main`). Accepts `local`/`uncommitted`, `branch [base]`, `commit [ref]`, or `auto`.

Steps:
1. Generate the change bundle with `bash .opencode/skills/autoreview/scripts/diff-bundle.sh --mode <mode> [--base <ref>] [--commit <ref>]` and read it fully.
2. Apply the rubric in `.opencode/skills/autoreview/references/rubric.md` and the schema in `.opencode/skills/autoreview/references/schema.json`.
3. Verify every finding by reading the real code path and adjacent files; read dependency docs/source/types when a finding depends on external behavior.
4. Return exactly one JSON object matching the schema and nothing else (no Markdown wrapper).
5. After the JSON, print a short human summary: command used, findings accepted/rejected with one-line reasons, and the clean/incorrect verdict.

Never edit, write, commit, push, or run anything destructive. If you encounter a secret/credential in the bundle, flag the risk in a `security` finding and do not reproduce the secret value.
